verdict.rationale: Codex supports MCP (local/remote servers) and explicitly mentions using it to connect to third-party tools like Figma and documentation, plus integrations with Slack/Linear/GitHub/GitLab for starting tasks, but there is no direct documented connector for Jira or Google Drive specifically. missing for 10: explicit Jira and Google Drive integration, independent hands-on confirmation of MCP connecting to these named workflow tools.
